$comment: Shape of the content JSON consumed by scripts/generate_mandate.js. See references/sample_content.json for a filled example (the Example Co mandate, the approved reference format).

client.legal_name: string, MANDATORY. Full registered name, e.g. 'Example Industries Private Limited'
client.brand_name: string, optional. Trade name, e.g. 'Example Co'. Leave empty if none; the 'operating under the brand' wording is then dropped
client.short_name: string, MANDATORY. Defined term used throughout, e.g. 'Example Co'
client.registered_office: string, MANDATORY. Client registered office address as it should appear in the Preamble

engagement.title_line1: string, optional. Defaults to 'Strategic Advisory and Growth Partnership'
engagement.nature: string, optional. Cover table 'Nature of Engagement'. Defaults to the approved Example Co wording
engagement.retainer_fee: string, MANDATORY. Amount with words, e.g. 'Rs. 1,00,000/- (One Lakh)'. The script appends 'plus applicable taxes' itself
engagement.success_fee_pct: string. MANDATORY QUESTION, optional value: e.g. '2%'. Empty string means 'to be decided mutually as and when applicable' (the Example Co wording)
engagement.date_display: string, MANDATORY. e.g. '16th September 2026'. Ordinal suffix renders as superscript in the signature block

background.business_description: string, MANDATORY. One to two sentences on what the client does, from user supplied facts only. The script appends the fixed 'As the Company pursues its growth plans...' sentence

pillar_bullets: array of up to 6 strings, optional. Overrides the default bullet under pillars A to F by position; empty entries keep the default

signature.client_name: string, MANDATORY. With title, e.g. 'Mr. A. Sample'
signature.advisor_name: string, MANDATORY. With title, e.g. 'Mr. A. Partner'
